changelog: Fixes channel settings appearing to do nothing: an edited channel went on airing its old schedule for several minutes, because the cached schedule was only dropped on a configuration-changed event that never arrives. Program blocks, play order and slot times now take effect the moment they are saved.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
